summary: Implemented strict signed mailbox transport, atomic native decrypt/inbox/encrypted history/pending ack, restart ack retry and exact redelivery deduplication. Added outbound history in its native/outbox transaction. All 10 unchanged T25 tests, 28 CLI tests, 73 workspace tests and workspace typechecks pass.

acceptance.criterion: Ten focused T25 tests pass unchanged

acceptance.evidence: Tests verify all three signatures and reject unknown/malformed/expired response data.
Commit failure injection verifies rollback including prekey consumption and zero acknowledgements.

acceptance.criterion: Restart and exact redelivery avoid repeated decrypt/history
acceptance.evidence: Ack-only restart and native snapshot equivalence regressions PASS.
Real reply exchange, offline reopen, plaintext redaction and outbound commit rollback PASS.
pnpm test 73 PASS; pnpm typecheck PASS.

Added encrypted transaction-local monotonic history helpers.
Append history atomically with native state and outbox.
